headline: Linn Mercy Holds Hot as Nevish Line Goes Quiet
war_summary: Morning wires show the Nevish Line falling silent in the last two hours after a busy night, with no transfers since 0410 though 22 in six hours and 47 on the day about Mistle Shrine, Princefal and the Scrying Belt for six Colonial and two Warden posts, day losses at 12,065 Colonial and 14,263 Warden now cooling. The Weathered Expanse eases to three in two hours, twelve in six and fifty on the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance for five Warden, one Colonial and three ruined posts, with 6,889 Colonial and 6,766 Warden losses cooling from the prior watch. Linn Mercy holds hot at five in two hours, eleven in six and thirty-seven on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for ten Colonial and one ruined post, last heard at 0555. Stonecradle and Mooring County record no transfers in two and six hours, last heard at 2031 about World's End and at 2243 about the Wind Hills, while Stlican Shelf shows three on the day about Briar and Callahan's Passage bleeds heavily with 3,832 Colonial and 3,123 Warden losses but no transfers.
